metadata.title: Global research data requirements and remaining skill gaps
metadata.geographic_requirement: Worldwide; no listing-market default. Match observations to company operating/customer/input exposure.
metadata.catalog_scope: Reusable source families and datasets across the twenty sector guides. A scoped requirements catalogue, not every possible vendor or a claim of complete live world coverage.
metadata.working_directory_review: Assessment of the eighteen bundled research skills and relevant references; no new live-agent benchmark was executed.
metadata.source_status: Official documentation/product/release pages reviewed. No new feed, subscription, API entitlement, bulk permission or production parser was established.
metadata.existing_adapters: The bundle contains adapters for AlphaPai, Alpha Vantage, API Ninjas and Massive. No credentials, universal country/field coverage or delivery rights are included; validate actual access before selecting a route.

sectors.name: Software / SaaS
required_observations: public peer retention and sales-efficiency definitions
sectors.foundational_build: Customer cohorts and usage x retention/expansion x realized price, constrained by sales capacity and cash investment.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: NRR/churn, contract timing, sales productivity, cloud commitments and product mix remain issuer-specific disclosed/judgment inputs.
sectors.common_error: Equating global IT spending growth with one company's ARR or revenue; treating provider forecasts as actual spending.

sectors.name: Semiconductors
sectors.foundational_build: End-market units x chip content/share, or wafer starts x yield x net wafer price; build capacity, cost and investment separately.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Process/node yields, customer exposure, utilization and contract pricing need issuer/peer evidence and supported estimates.
sectors.common_error: Using a smoothed industry sales index as a single month; applying memory prices to logic or foundry pricing.

sectors.name: Hardware / devices / contract manufacturing
sectors.foundational_build: Units by product/geography x net ASP; BOM and conversion cost, inventory/working capital and capacity investment.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: BOM content, customer allocations, channel inventory and company product/region mix are not supplied by global aggregates.
sectors.common_error: Treating shipment growth as sell-through or average export unit value as a clean like-for-like ASP.

sectors.name: Internet platforms / ecommerce / ads
sectors.foundational_build: Transactions/GMV x net take rate, or monetizable impressions x realized CPM, plus fulfillment/subsidy and investment economics.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Conversion, net take, incentive incidence, paid-user cohorts and profitability require issuer evidence.
sectors.common_error: Treating visits/downloads as paid demand or GMV as revenue; combining gross and net ad/transaction bases.

sectors.name: Media / gaming / content
sectors.foundational_build: Title/release and payer cohorts x monetization/retention, or subscribers x net price; content cash and amortization schedules.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Title success, revenue share, content budgets, rights, deferred revenue and franchise durability still need direct evidence and ranges.
sectors.common_error: Mistaking store consumer spending for publisher net bookings or content cash spending for current-period expense.

sectors.name: Banks
sectors.foundational_build: Average earning assets x yield less average funding x cost; credit cohorts, fees, costs, RWA and distributable capital.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Loan/deposit mix, repricing, credit underwriting, concentration, capital rules and management provisions require institution-level evidence.
sectors.common_error: Using a generic net-debt enterprise-value bridge, or applying a national credit/NPL average directly to one bank.

sectors.name: Insurance / reinsurance
sectors.foundational_build: Exposure x net premium rate -> earned premiums; claims frequency/severity/reserves, investment and regulatory capital.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Loss development, guarantees, surrender behavior, reinsurance, IFRS/statutory bridges and remittance need issuer schedules.
sectors.common_error: Assuming premium growth proves underwriting profit or that reserve releases represent repeatable operating improvement.

sectors.name: Payments / fintech
sectors.foundational_build: Matched eligible transactions/value x net take, with incentives/network costs; funded lending and loss cohorts where relevant.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Net economics, routing, merchant mix, cohort losses and funding terms cannot be inferred from total payment values.
sectors.common_error: Counting wholesale payment flows as merchant spending or applying volume growth to revenue without a take-rate bridge.

sectors.name: Brokers / exchanges / asset managers
sectors.foundational_build: Average AUM x net fee, trading/clearing volume x realized fees, plus funded cash balances and associated expenses.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Mandate mix, performance fees, distribution rebates and capital/interest exposure need company disclosures.
sectors.common_error: Equating AUM changes with flows or exchange turnover with net capital buying.

sectors.name: Real estate / REITs
sectors.foundational_build: Area/rooms x occupancy x net rent/rate, lease expiries and costs -> cash NOI/AFFO; funding/capex and NAV separately.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Lease schedules, property mix, incentives, maintenance capex and debt terms remain company/asset-specific.
sectors.common_error: Using a global office average for a local logistics portfolio, or treating book NAV as automatically realizable owner value.

sectors.name: Pharma / biotech
sectors.foundational_build: Eligible treated population x adherence/duration x net realized price; timed clinical probability tree, costs and commercial rights.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Asset-specific clinical interpretation, actual net rebates, exclusivity, funding/runway and licensing terms require deeper analysis.
sectors.common_error: Multiplying peak sales by one success probability without timing/costs; treating registration or patent publication as proof of efficacy/exclusivity.

sectors.name: Healthcare services / devices / CRO-CDMO
sectors.foundational_build: Procedures/members/installed consumables or executable contract work x net price; staffing, utilization, collections and capacity investment.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Provider mix, payer rates, collections, cancellations, executable backlog and capacity constraints need company-level evidence.
sectors.common_error: Using registered trial counts as CRO revenue or national healthcare expenditure growth as a provider's same-store growth.

sectors.name: Consumer / retail / brands
sectors.foundational_build: Stores/cohorts or category units x share x net price/mix; promotions, procurement, logistics and funded working capital.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Same-store traffic/ticket, franchise economics, actual procurement/hedging and channel inventory remain issuer-specific.
sectors.common_error: Treating nominal category sales as volume or a commodity price change as immediate, full company margin pass-through.

sectors.name: Industrials / equipment / engineered projects
sectors.foundational_build: Market demand/share or executable orders -> deliveries/acceptance x net price; matched costs, installed-base service and capital.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Firm orders, delivery schedules, cost-to-complete, customer funding and service attachment need issuer evidence.
sectors.common_error: Applying broad capex/production growth to every machinery segment, or treating orders/backlog as cash or guaranteed sales.

sectors.name: Autos / EVs / components / batteries
sectors.foundational_build: Retail/wholesale bridge by product/region x net unit price; content/share for components, cost/utilization and finance exposure.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Product rollout, discounts, channel inventory, OEM allocation, factory yield and procurement remain company-specific.
sectors.common_error: Adding production, wholesale and registrations together; equating battery usage with cell shipments or storage-system demand.

sectors.name: Oil / gas / refining / energy infrastructure
sectors.foundational_build: Production/depletion or throughput x realized netback; extraction/refining costs, sustaining capex and contracted cash flows.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Field decline, project timing, refinery slate, contracts, hedges and actual operating costs need asset/company evidence.
sectors.common_error: Using one benchmark for every realized price or confusing gross margin with cash after sustaining investment.

sectors.name: Utilities / power / renewable projects
sectors.foundational_build: Available capacity x output/capacity factor x net tariff/PPA, or regulated rate base x allowed return; capex and funding constraints.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Asset location, curtailment, contracts, local regulation, project budgets and debt/equity funding remain company-specific.
sectors.common_error: Turning capacity additions directly into earnings or using national generation averages for a differently located asset fleet.

sectors.name: Metals / mining
sectors.foundational_build: Ore x grade x recovery x payability x realized netback; mine life, costs, sustaining/growth capex and closure obligations.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Mine grade, recoveries, life, sustaining capex and contracts require technical reports/issuer evidence.
sectors.common_error: Inferring mine costs/grades from global metal prices, or subtracting sustaining capex twice after a cash-cost metric that already includes it.

sectors.name: Telecom / towers
sectors.foundational_build: Active connection cohorts x realized ARPU, or leased sites x tenancy x rent; network capex, spectrum and lease/funding cash.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Churn, billing mix, actual network costs, spectrum payments and lease obligations need issuer/local evidence.
sectors.common_error: Treating subscriptions as people or a standardized country price basket as operator net ARPU.

sectors.name: Airlines / shipping / rail / logistics / airports
sectors.foundational_build: Capacity x load x unit yield or volume x net price; fuel/handling/labor/lease cost and committed capacity investment.
sectors.still_requires_company_evidence: Network mix, contracts, ancillary revenues, hedges, fleet commitments and receivables need issuer/asset evidence.
sectors.common_error: Multiplying an already revenue-per-capacity measure by load factor again, or mixing daily spot freight with contracted realized revenue.
